verdict: Deputy: Choose Deputy when multi-location shift work, timekeeping, and compliance are the job — not when you need a free SMB tier, restaurant-only WFM, or a core HRIS. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Location hierarchies and SSO on Pro
bestFor: Multi-location hourly operators who need scheduling + time + labor compliance
Teams that will trial Core for up to 31 days before Homebase-style SMB hubs
Ops leaders who want WFM AI with a human-in-the-loop
notIdealFor: Tiny shops that need a free ≤10-employee plan
Buyers whose primary job is core HRIS or structured ATS
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth
Opaque contact-sales pricing vs transparent published seats
recommendation: Choose Deputy when multi-location shift work, timekeeping, and compliance are the job — not when you need a free SMB tier, restaurant-only WFM, or a core HRIS. Compare Connecteam for deskless hubs, Homebase for cheaper SMB locations, When I Work for low per-user scheduling, and 7shifts for restaurants.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Deeper than Homebase/When I Work; still shift-work native. Score reflects mid-market WFM admin, not lab testing.
Primary job is frontline WFM with compliance and timekeeping. Scored inside WFM — not an ATS or HRIS peer.
Auto-scheduling, forecasting, biometrics, and location hierarchies on Core/Pro are the deepest P2 WFM workflows.
Payroll/POS and identity connectors plus Paycor US payroll path are solid for shift-work stacks.
Clock, swaps, and messaging are built for hourly mobile use.
Analytics+ / Pro reporting is stronger than SMB schedulers.
Per-user plus location hierarchies and Enterprise-adjacent Pro features support multi-site growth.
Add-ons, manager billing, and the $30 floor depress value versus $2.50 When I Work scheduling. Affiliate economics excluded.
Deputy AI (human-in-the-loop for schedules/timesheets) plus Core+ auto-scheduling is a real WFM AI story.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
